body:
# Cookie Superheroes

A modern Minecraft superhero modpack focused on action, powers, and multiplayer fun.

I always wanted to find the perfect superhero modpack for modern Minecraft, so I decided to make my own.

The core superhero experience is powered by [Palladium](https://modrinth.com/mod/threetag-palladium) and the addon [FSang18's Heroes](https://modrinth.com/mod/fsang18s-heropack), bringing a huge variety of powers inspired by Marvel, DC, anime, and more.

The modpack also includes:

* Performance and optimization mods
* Quality of life improvements
* Tech mods like Create
* Multiplayer-friendly gameplay
* Modern Forge 1.20.1 support
